newsitem.title: USA: Suburban Propane still sees margin pressure.
newsitem.headline: Suburban Propane still sees margin pressure.

text.p: Suburban Propane Partners LP said Tuesday as it released its year-end results for the 1996 fiscal year that it remains concerned about continued margin pressure.
President and Chief Executive Mark Alexander said in a statement that its concerns are "as a result of low propane inventory levels and high product costs."

For the fourth quarter ended September 28, the company posted a net loss of $17.1 million, or $0.58 per share, on revenues of $126.7 million. Those results included a reorganization charge of $2.3 million, or $0.08 per share.
For the same period in the prior year, the company posted a net loss of $15.6 million, or $0.53 per share, on revenues of $108.5 million.
